info.title: Chrono Sandbox API
info.description: REST API for executing scripts in isolated sandbox environments via OpenSandbox. Supports synchronous, streaming, and asynchronous execution plus persistent sessions.

post.summary: Execute a script in an isolated sandbox environment.

input_files.description: Files to inject into the sandbox before execution.

language.description: Execution language. Supported: python, javascript, typescript, bash, go, java.

network_enabled.description: Whether the sandbox has network access (default: true).

output_type.description: Output type: "text" for stdout-only, "file" for file retrieval.

post.summary: Execute a script with Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming output.
post.description:
The `200 OK` + headers are flushed **immediately** — before the sandbox is
created — so intermediary time-to-first-byte caps (e.g. Cloudflare's ~100s)
never trip during slow sandbox creation. A `progress` heartbeat is emitted at
once and then every [`STREAM_HEARTBEAT_SECS`] until the script's stdout/stderr
and terminal `complete` event are streamed. A post-open failure is delivered
as an `error` event (the status is already `200`).

status.description:
Execution state exposed by the additive `/executions` API.
`succeeded` means the script produced a known result; callers must still
inspect `ExecuteResponse.success` because a non-zero exit is a known result,
not an infrastructure failure.
